newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 3.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - June 3.

text.p: -- Seagate Technology Inc, one of the largest U.S. makers of computer disk drives, said its fiscal fourth quarter results would be below expectations due to weak demand for its high-performance computer disk drive products. Analysts had expected the company to earn $1.06 per share in the quarter, according to First Call.

-- Ford Motor Co is expected to post record quarterly profits in the second quarter, surpassing the $1.9 billion, or $1.56 per share, it earned a year earlier, the Wall Street Journal reported. The newspaper cited individuals close to the company and Wall Street analysts.

-- Enron Corp is expected to anounce a joint venture under which it will acquire about $3 billion of the generating assets of Italian utility L'Ente Nazionale per L'Energia Elettrica, the Wall Street Journal reported.

-- ITT Corp is considering bids to sell some of its premier properties under terms that could prevent Hilton Hotels, which has made a takeover bid for ITT, from owning or managing them, the Wall Street Journal reported.
